name: TypeSafe
summary: Jev, a System One model that answers typed questions (choice, score, yes/no, image box) about text or images with calibrated probabilities instead of generated prose.
notes: Billed per input token only (output is free): $0.042 per million tokens on Jev 1.13 and 1.14 (models page, 2026-11).
Ask many questions in one request: the state is read once and every question is answered in parallel, so batching is far cheaper than one call per question.
Limits: 64k tokens per request and 32k per question unless the long-context header is set (262k each); bodies at most 32 MiB. 429 and 529 mean back off and retry.

endpoints.name: List models
endpoints.summary: Model names and aliases (such as jev-latest) available to the account.

endpoints.name: Answer typed questions about content
endpoints.summary: Send a state (text, object or array) and named questions; get one typed answer per question with probabilities and confidence.

model.description: Model name or alias from typesafe.models.list.

state.description: The content every question refers to: a string, a JSON object or an array.

example.subject: Duplicate charge
example.message: I was charged twice this month. Please refund the extra charge.

questions.description: Named questions. Each has type noul (yes/no, answers a 0-1 probability), choice (criteria: {label: description}), score (criteria: ordered list of levels) or box (find something in an image); instructions says what to decide.

tone.instructions: What is the tone of this message?

assets.description: Images keyed by a placeholder string used inside state, instructions or criteria: {type: image, format: png|jpg|jpeg, data_base64}. Needs the images header.

long_context.description: Send 'true' to raise both context limits to 262k tokens.

images.description: Send 'true' to use assets or box questions.

notes: A read over POST; billed per input token.
Answers come back under the same names as the questions, with the model used and token usage.
